title: source/control/v1
description: The authority's source-control state (spec 04 §3.6 source/control; U-15; LESSONS B-09, B-11), in the common envelope: the value of KV bucket source_control key "state" and the message on ctl.sources, written only by api (internal/sources/switches) and followed by every process (internal/sources). Internal to this system: NATS never crosses a system (02 §1), so this shape is this repository's own (M14, M30). Followers apply a state only when its version is strictly higher within the same epoch, and any state under another epoch; with none they enable everything (never fail closed). The decision is uspace-core sources.State.Query; the knowledge vector source_control.json pins it.

epoch.description: Random per source_controls table creation, and new when api finds the bucket ahead of its database (a restored database).

version.description: The last value of source_control_version_seq drawn for a change: it only rises within an epoch.

default_deny.description: An instance with no row of its own is disabled (why: default_deny) unless its type is on (SOURCES_DEFAULT_DENY).

actor.description: Who switched it, as the audit log names them (02 F9 "disabled by <who>").
